ticket.title: Add the repository to the telemetry span contract
ticket.description: TelemetrySpan carries span_id, trace_id, parent_span_id, binary, command, task_key, branch, status, started_at_ms, duration_ms and first_diagnostic, and no repository. Federation encoded ownership in the log path, so rooting telemetry at the suite deletes that encoding: one log could no longer say which repository a miter run touched, and branch does not disambiguate two worktrees on one branch name. Add repo. Also populate task_key where a span is opened: sawhorse completion_span sets command and never task_key, so both spans currently on disk carry neither field and the join to the spool sits at zero coverage. This is a contract change under ADR 0002 and lands before the writer moves.
acceptance_criteria: a span round-trips repo; a span with no repo is legal for a run outside any checkout and the panel groups unknowns explicitly; the two fields are populated by the emitting helper, proven by a test that opens a span with a task key
